title: File handle leaked on the early-return path
description: A project-owned semantic review case where a context-managed file read is rewritten to a manual open that leaks the handle when a match is found.
diff:
diff --git a/src/report_reader.py b/src/report_reader.py
--- a/src/report_reader.py
+++ b/src/report_reader.py
@@ -1,8 +1,10 @@
 def first_matching_line(path: str, needle: str) -> str | None:
     """Return the first line in path containing needle, or None if absent."""
-    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
-        for line in handle:
-            if needle in line:
-                return line.rstrip("\n")
+    handle = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8")
 
+    for line in handle:
+        if needle in line:
+            return line.rstrip("\n")
+
+    handle.close()
     return None

expectedFindings.semanticSummary: the file is opened without a context manager and the early return on a match skips handle.close(), leaking the file descriptor on the common path
